hypothesis: Eligible accepted macro exposure adds incremental selection value to the existing deterministic Opportunity Hunter ranking.
control: Frozen base composite; no accepted macro features, no LLM reselection, no learned challenger adjustment.
treatment: Same ranking plus an equal-weight structural defensiveness adjustment. Inflation is beneficial; rate, dollar and geopolitical exposures are adverse. This tests this fixed ranking rule, not all possible uses of macro.
missing_dimension_policy: zero incremental contribution; never impute a score or renormalize weights
primary: Mean paired SPY-relative alpha difference on divergent cohorts at 63 trading sessions (approximately 90 calendar days).
graduation: Diversity, divergence, clustered uncertainty, effect and risk jointly required. Milestone count is not proof. Early horizons cannot graduate the experiment. Promotion requires a separate explicit production change.
ablation_analysis: Exploratory only on originally frozen prospective candidates; no rescoring with current data and no production challengers.
